title: Sprint 2 — User Authentication & JWT Flow
description: Implement user registration, credential verification, login, and JWT access token issuance.

learning_objectives: Validate incoming JSON request payloads in Spring Boot.
Handle uniqueness checks and HTTP 409 Conflict status.
Store passwords securely using BCrypt hashing.
hints: Encode password using passwordEncoder.encode(password) before saving.
tickets.title: Ticket 1 - User Registration API
tickets.description:
Build the POST /api/auth/register endpoint to allow new users to create accounts.

### Request Body
`json
{
  "username": "johndoe",
  "email": "john@example.com",
  "password": "securepassword123"
}
``n
### Requirements
1. Validate that username, email, and password are provided and non-empty. Return 400 Bad Request if missing.
2. Validate that username and email are not already taken. Return 409 Conflict with {"error": "User or email already exists"} if duplicate.
3. Create the user, securely hashing the password using BCrypt.
4. Return 201 Created with {"message": "User registered successfully", "user": {...}} omitting the password hash.
common_mistakes: Returning HTTP 200 instead of HTTP 201 Created on new resource creation.
Returning the password_hash in the registration response.

tasks.title: Validate required fields (username, email, password) in request JSON.
Check for existing user/email and return HTTP 409 on duplicate.
Save user to database and return HTTP 201 with serialized user data.

learning_objectives: Authenticate credentials against hashed passwords using PasswordEncoder.matches().
Generate and sign JWT access tokens with JJWT.
tickets.title: Ticket 2 - User Login & JWT Token Generation
tickets.description:
Build the POST /api/auth/login endpoint that authenticates a user and returns a signed JSON Web Token (JWT).

### Request Body
`json
{
  "email": "john@example.com",
  "password": "securepassword123"
}
``n
### Requirements
1. Validate that email and password are present. Return 400 Bad Request if missing.
2. Query user by email. If not found or if password does not match, return 401 Unauthorized with {"error": "Invalid credentials"}.
3. Generate a JWT token containing user_id and expiration claim.
4. Return 200 OK with {"token": "<jwt_token>", "user": {...}}.
common_mistakes: Distinguishing between 'User not found' and 'Invalid password' in error messages (security risk).
Omitting expiration claim in the JWT payload.

tasks.title: Validate credentials against the database using password verification.
Generate JWT token with user ID and expiration claims.
Return HTTP 200 with JWT token and user profile.

learning_objectives: Create custom Spring Security OncePerRequestFilter for request authorization.
hints: Register JwtFilter before UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter in SecurityConfig.
Inject Authentication into getMe(Authentication auth) to access the authenticated User principal.
tickets.title: Ticket 3 - Token Verification & Current User Profile
tickets.description:
Implement authentication filter JwtFilter extending OncePerRequestFilter and build GET /api/auth/me to retrieve the current logged-in user.

### Requirements
1. Implement JwtFilter in src/main/java/com/yuvro/todo/config/JwtFilter.java.
2. Extract token from Authorization: Bearer <token> header.
3. Return 401 Unauthorized if header is missing, token is malformed, or token has expired.
4. Decode token, lookup user from database, and set UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken in SecurityContextHolder.
5. Implement GET /api/auth/me returning {"user": current_user.toDict()}.
common_mistakes: Forgetting to check if Authorization header starts with Bearer .
Not configuring uthenticationEntryPoint returning HTTP 401 on unauthorized requests.

tasks.title: Implement GET /api/auth/me endpoint protected by authentication.
